jc.t: First murti pratishtha on the American continent: Akshar Purushottam Maharaj installed for the first time
w: "I am happy because Yogiji Maharaj's wish has been fulfilled." Devotees travelled 5,000 to 6,000 km to attend.
In the evening assembly, Swamishri was honored from the Governor of Atlanta's office and also offered the 'Key to the City of Clarkstown' by Mayor George Baldesare of Clarkstown.
At 10.55 a.m. Swamishri arrived in Bhalej village. After performing pujan and arti of murtis at the Swaminarayan Mandir, Swamishri blessed the assembly and returned to Anand.

ds.t: Take refuge in God and worship Him
w: During the 181 meetings after breakfast, a promising youth from Ahmedabad came to Pramukh Swami Maharaj. His father had brought him. Because of excessive sensitivity, the youth had become depressed. Saddened by the corruption and many problems in the country, he kept feeling that he alone should set it all right. But not seeing any result, he now wishes to go to the banks of the Narmada, meditate and do austerities to reform the country. Swamishri listened fully to the account of his depression. After his father had presented it, Swamishri, addressing the youth, said, "Whatever we do, we should do while staying at home. There is no need to leave home. Do puja and prayers every day. In them keep praying to God that the world improves. Read good scriptures so that we find peace. And if you are thinking of bringing peace to the world, that will not happen even by going to the banks of the Narmada. Basically, take refuge in God, worship Him and pray. Whatever support we give in that way is our seva. Otherwise, do your job or business, stay at home, serve your parents, carry out that responsibility and keep doing bhajan." Swamishri showed him the shortest path to world peace.
Wednesday, 3 August 2005 (Vikram Samvat 2061, Ashadh vad 14), Bochasan

There was a letter from a devotee. His business was not doing well, so he had consulted an astrologer. The astrologer had given him a horseshoe. He kept it in the house for a week, but nothing changed. So this devotee looked within and wrote to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "My conviction has faltered, so now what atonement should I do?"
Swamishri said, "Be careful that this does not happen again, and keep firm. Whatever is done, Shriji Maharaj does. Shriji Maharaj must be doing only what is good for us."
